title: Hot-air balloon over Luxor
standfirst: A sunrise balloon flight over the West Bank of Luxor, the temples and fields below. This extra is information only for now. It is one of our [[up]].

sections.heading: The flight
paragraphs: Balloons lift off from the West Bank at dawn and drift over the fields, villages and temples for about an hour, depending on the wind.

sections.heading: Booking
paragraphs: We don’t take bookings for balloon flights yet. This page will show prices and dates once a supplier is confirmed.

faqs.q: How early does the balloon leave?
faqs.a: Pickups are usually before dawn, to be in the air at sunrise.

seoDescription: A sunrise hot-air balloon flight over the West Bank of Luxor: what it is like, and when it can be booked.
